svg.title: Stracer backend testing process
svg.desc: Run checks against the exact release artifact; keep test evidence for every promotion decision.
svg.text: Stracer backend testing process
Run checks against the exact release artifact; keep test evidence for every promotion decision.
1. Build and static review
Restore / Release build; dependency and secret review; inspect open security findings.
Existing vapt-baseline.ps1 produces reports; a zero audit exit code does not prove no findings.
2. Logic and parser regressions
Diagnostic timing, site CSV validation, L3 summaries, network fallback and fixtures.
Console runner: CallAnalyzerRegression; dotnet test alone does not execute its modes.
3. Session, cache, and RF regressions
Select session-continuity, sessions-pagination, network-log-cache and RF modes.
Review each mode?s fixtures and external requirements; flags select separate execution paths.
4. Staging database and integration checks
IN/TW persistence, Redis, S3, SMTP / webhook delivery, Python bridge read and save.
Use designated disposable test data; database-backed modes may modify their test databases.
5. API, security, and end-to-end tests
Login ? scoped data; upload ? dashboard; RF ZIP ? PDF ? download; WebSockets.
Test role / company / region isolation, API-key rejection, CSRF, cookies, logout and reset.
6. Performance and recovery tests
Representative concurrency / data; DB and Redis outages; worker leases and retries.
Agree latency / error targets; GET-only load script is not a complete workload test.
7. Staging acceptance and promotion
Record expected versus actual data, reports, permissions and integration behavior.
Promote only when agreed gates pass; retain artifact hash, logs and acceptance evidence.
8. Production smoke validation
API-key health probes, Redis verification, IN/TW login, scoped reads and workers.
Readiness can return HTTP 200 while Redis is unavailable: inspect checks and test login.
9. Monitor after rollout
Watch application errors / latency, DB / Redis, queued jobs and delivery failures.
Investigate regressions promptly; trigger rollback / recovery if production gates fail.
On any failed check
Capture reproducible inputs,
expected / actual results and logs.
Classify code, configuration,
schema, fixture or infrastructure.
Fix the failing condition.
Rebuild / repackage if changed.
Rerun affected checks plus
release gates impacted by the fix.
Do not promote a failed artifact.
Production failure: follow the
rollback / recovery flow.
Never report unrun tests as passed.
Fail
Revalidate after recovery
Existing automation covers selected regression modes; HTTP integration, recovery and acceptance need explicit execution.
Health endpoints use /healthz, not the load script?s default /health path; configure authentication explicitly.
Documentation only: this update did not execute the application build, test suite, or staging / production checks.
